scenario.title: Lake Kastoria
intro.text:
LAKE KASTORIA - 15 APR 1941

Lake Kastoria, West Macedonia

As expected, the Germans invaded our country in support of their unsuccessful Allies, the Italians. Our East Macedonia Army capitulated already, our forces in Western Macedonia are destroyed and the Germans are close to Kozani. Thus our main forces in Albania threatens to cut off! We have no other choice but to immediate withdrawal from Albania. Advance with your troops immediately to Lake Kastoria and save our line of retreat!

GOAL Retreat 6 ground units via Exit Point or hold after the ninth turn 4 VH for BV! Hold after the ninth turn 3 VH or 2 VH for V or TV!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-3-0-briliant.speaker: Alexandros Papagos
line.reaction-3-0-briliant.text: All ten positions held against the Italians. Now the German columns are moving through the Balkans. Send me the transport returns; we may have to move headquarters before the next attack.
line.reaction-3-1-victory-tactical.text: We recovered the last positions and stopped the spring offensive. Headquarters is already asking which formations can move north. I haven't had time to rest them.
line.callback-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-0.text: The Kastoria battalions heard that we took the wireless truck west. They've asked when we can reach them. The Thessaloniki officers are asking who they should call instead.
line.callback-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-1.text: I defended going to Thessaloniki because we need the fleet. The western officers asked what transport we'd left them. I had to admit how little there was.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.earned-decision.text: The Trebeshinë reserve has reached Kastoria without losing a company. Its major says he can cover the lake road. Three weakened battalions say they can cover it if he gives them his men.
line.earned-decision.choice.keep-the-wes: Keep the mountain reserve as a separate battalion.
Add an experienced seven-strength mountain infantry detachment.
line.earned-decision.choice.fill-the-wes: Distribute its veterans and replacements through the withdrawing core.
Restore every core formation to at least eight strength and give infantry 10 experience.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.earned-a-response.text: The major keeps his battalion and the next ridge. He understands that surviving intact has earned him the first difficult job.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.earned-b-response.text: Send his veterans to the weakest battalions before dawn. Give their major the assignments; he can help the receiving officers settle them in.
line.scene-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-0.text: Dendrochori has three headquarters in it and room for none. Their clerks keep asking which road is reserved for them. I keep pointing south.
line.scene-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-1.text: German patrols are feeling for the lake road. Hold the northern posts too long and they miss the exit; pull them now and the patrols reach the column.
line.decision.speaker: Alexandros Papagos
line.decision.text: Fix a closing hour and defend Dendrochori until it, or shorten the front before the road becomes a trap.
line.decision.choice.hold-dendrochori.te: Reinforce Dendrochori and the northern road until the closing hour.
line.decision.choice.hold-dendrochori.hi: Give infantry and anti-tank formations 15 experience and restore the core to at least eight strength with full ammunition.
line.decision.choice.shorten-the-positio: Shorten the front now and prepare a staged withdrawal to the exit.
Fully refuel the core and give reconnaissance 15 experience.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: Give me the hour in ink. A captain under attack will always hear 'hold until relieved,' even when nobody said it.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Alexandros Papagos
line.choice-a-1.text: Write the hour on every order. Dendrochori is to be evacuated then, even if a captain thinks he can hold longer. The western columns still need that road.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.choice-b-0.text: We will be accused of opening the approach before the column was clear.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-b-1.text: They can accuse us when we get out. The exposed companies move before dawn. I'll leave the last trucks to lift the roadblocks.
